audit.why: Camille takes levels 1-5 and both item stages, level 6 is skill — identical to the Camille-side chart, and consistent with a 50.58% coin-flip over 259 games where Cho'Gath's only edge is the Feast window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes referenced 'Hookshot's cooldown' with no number and called Feast 'your committal tool'.
audit.why: Hookshot is 16/15/14/13/12s, Precision Protocol 9/8/7/6/5s, Tactical Sweep 15/14/13/12/11s, The Hextech Ultimatum 140/115/90s. Hookshot at 16s rank 1 is the longest window in her kit and the only one worth building a step-up around.
audit.corrected: Windows keyed to Hookshot at 16s, Precision Protocol at 9s, Tactical Sweep at 15s, Feast at 80s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The interaction line read 'Her engage/stun. Silence/peel it.' — no ability behaviour, no consequence, no numbers.
audit.why: Three real interactions were missing. Hookshot requires a wall, so Feral Scream's silence removes both her entry and her exit rather than merely delaying them. Adaptive Defenses shields her against the damage type that just hit her — Feast is true damage, so the shield reads zero against it, which the Camille-side audit confirms from her direction. Tactical Sweep only slows and heals off its outer half, so walking through the inner cone denies her the heal.
audit.corrected: Feral Scream stops Hookshot being cast (16s at rank 1); Feast is true damage so Adaptive Defenses reads zero; the outer half of Tactical Sweep is what heals her.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal guidance anywhere despite it being flagged for this matchup.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/_missing/chogath.json lists Camille as needs-antiheal via Tactical Sweep. Her heal is on a 15s cooldown and lands every time she catches you in the outer cone, which is exactly the grind Cho'Gath is trying to win.
audit.corrected: Tactical Sweep heals off the outer half — bring Grievous Wounds.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention of the Precision Protocol tell.
audit.why: Her combo opens with an auto-attack reset and the second cast hits much harder if she delays between the two attacks — so the pause after her first empowered hit is the dangerous moment, not the cast. No writable field had room for it inside the length band.
